messages.content: Write only C# statements constructing a PicoGK Voxels variable named result. Allowed APIs: new BaseCone(LocalFrame,float length,float startRadius,float endRadius).voxConstruct(); new BasePipe(LocalFrame,float length,float innerRadius,float outerRadius).voxConstruct(); new LocalFrame(new Vector3(xf,yf,zf)); result.BoolSubtract(bore); result.BoolAdd(inlet); result.BoolAdd(outlet). Use exactly four declarations: Voxels result, Voxels bore, Voxels inlet, Voxels outlet; and three boolean calls. Numeric float literals ending f only. No other APIs, expressions, comments, loops, markdown or explanation. All dimensions are owner-declared synthetic design variables, not measured Porsche data.

Recreate this stationary cold-side diffuser concept in mm. Bore diameter at z=0 is 50; bore diameter at z=90 is 68. Body axial length is 90 and radial wall thickness is 4. Build result as the outer cone; subtract bore as the inner cone. The inlet flange is a pipe from z=-8 to z=0.5, inner diameter 50, outer diameter 74. The outlet flange is a pipe from z=89.5 to z=98, inner diameter 68, outer diameter 92. Union both flange pipes into result after subtracting the bore. Frames use x=y=0. Convert diameters to radii and calculate the flange lengths from the stated z intervals.
